qa_pairs.question: What type of data does the "Mémoire gaspillée GPUEN.png" graph present in the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: The "Mémoire gaspillée GPUEN.png" graph in the Metrix portal illustrates the amount of GPU memory wasted by each user.

qa_pairs.question: In which section of the Metrix portal can users view the graph detailing wasted GPU memory per user?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can view the graph detailing wasted GPU memory per user within the "GPU accounts" section of the Metrix portal.
